Akulona idamu lokugcina izinto kodwa i-anicut: i-weir ebamba umfula ukuze uphendule amanzi awo abe yimigudu. Umnyombo wasendulo uwudonga oluphansi lwetshe elingaqoshwe amamitha angaba ngu-330 ubude; ibhuloho elikhothamele kanye nezikhala ezibonwa namuhla zakhiwe phezu kwalo ngekhulu leshumi nesishiyagalolunye namashumi amabili.
Kallanai was built without mortar, on th: I-Kallanai yakhiwe ngaphandle kodaka, esihlabathini esishintshayo somfula. Abakhi bayo bagingqa amatshe amakhulu angaqoshwanga eKaveri; njengoba umsinga wawukhuculula isihlabathi ngaphansi kwawo amatshe acwila, futhi amanye anqwabelaniswa phezulu kwaze kwaba yilapho inqwaba ihlezi emhlabathini oqinile. Ubumba nodaka lwezikhukhula kwagcwalisa izikhala futhi kwabopha amatshe emgodleni owodwa ongangeni manzi: udonga oluphansi, olubanzi olungaba amamitha angu-330 ubude namamitha angaba ngu-20 ububanzi, olubekwe emugqeni osontayo owufanisa nenyoka ekhasayo. Kuyi-anicut, hhayi ichibi - iphakamisa umfula ngokwanele ukuthumela amanzi awo eziteshini, futhi idedele okunye kudlule.
Kallanai, also known as the Grand Anicut: I-Kallanai, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-Grand Anicut, ingesinye sezibonelo eziphawuleka kakhulu zobunjiniyela bamanzi bendabuko eTamil Nadu. Ima ngaphesheya koMfula iKaveri futhi ngokwesiko kuthiwa uKarikala Chola, inkosi yakuqala yamaChola. Lesi sakhiwo sasiklanyelwe ukuphambukisa amanzi omfula ukuya emiseleni yokunisela esikhundleni sokumane sigcine amanzi echibini. Idamu lisize ukusabalalisa amanzi e-Kaveri emazweni omhlaba avundile e-delta, lapho ukutshalwa kwerayisi kwaba okubaluleke kakhulu. Isakhiwo sayo samatshe esiphansi, esibanzi sisebenza nokugeleza komfula ukuqondisa amanzi kumanethiwekhi okunisela. Ngokungafani nedamu lesimanje eliphakeme, injongo yalo eyinhloko kwakuwukuphambukiswa nokusatshalaliswa kwamanzi. I-Kallanai imele ubudlelwano obuseduze phakathi kokuphathwa kwemifula, ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo kanye nokuhlala endaweni yaseTamil. Indima yayo eqhubekayo ohlelweni lokunisela futhi ikhombisa ukuthi izakhiwo zobunjiniyela bendabuko zingahlala ziwusizo kanjani ngokulungiswa nokujwayela. Nakuba usuku lwayo olunembile lokwakha lungaqinisekile, luhlotshaniswa kakhulu nenkathi yokuqala ye-Chola.

Keezhadi is an important archaeological: I-Keezhadi iyindawo ebalulekile yokuvubukula eduze nomfula iVaigai esifundeni saseSivaganga. Kurinji represents mountainous regions w: I-Kurinji imelela izifunda ezinezintaba lapho ukuzingela, ukuqoqa umkhiqizo wamahlathi nokutshala izitshalo ezifanele kwakuyizindlela ezibalulekile zokuthola ukudla. Ukudla okuhlotshaniswa ne-Kurinji: thinai (i-foxtail millet), uju, izithelo zasendle, irayisi loqalo lapho uqalo luqhakaza khona, izigaxa zehlathi nezimpande, inyama yokuzingela, nemifino edliwayo namantongomane. Madurai represents the enduring relation: I-Madurai imele ubudlelwano obuhlala njalo phakathi kwezincwadi zesiTamil, ukusekelwa kwasebukhosini, amasiko enkolo nempilo yasemadolobheni.
Madurai was one of the most important ce: IMadurai yayingesinye sezikhungo ezibaluleke kakhulu zombuso wasendulo wasePandya. Ihlotshaniswa eduze namasiko emibhalo yesiTamil kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinkondlo zesiTamil zakudala. Imibhalo yasendulo ichaza iMadurai njengedolobha elichumayo lapho kwabuthana khona izimbongi, izazi, abathengisi nababusi. Idolobhakazi liphinde labamba iqhaza elikhulu kwezohwebo, empilweni yezenkolo nasekuhwebeni kwamasiko. Nakuba izincazelo ze-Madurai yasendulo zisekhona emithonjeni yezincwadi, ukuvela kwayo ngqo ngesikhathi se-Sangam akukwazi ukwakhiwa kabusha ngokuqiniseka okuphelele.
Mamallapuram showcases the creativity, c: I-Mamallapuram ikhombisa ubuhlakani, ubuciko kanye nokuqanjwa kabusha kwezakhiwo zenkathi yePallava.
Mamallapuram, also known as Mahabalipura: I-Mamallapuram, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-Mahabalipuram, ithuthukiswe njengesikhungo esibalulekile se-Pallava yobuciko nezakhiwo. Ababusi basePallava basekela ukwakhiwa kwemigede eqoshiwe, izikhumbuzo ze-monolithic, ama-sculptural panel namathempeli akhiwe. Phakathi kwezikhumbuzo zayo ezidume kakhulu kukhona amaRatha amahlanu, iThempeli Lasogwini, kanye nokukhululeka okukhulu okuvame ukubizwa ngokuthi I-Arjuna's Penance noma Ukwehla KweGanges. Le misebenzi ikhombisa ikhono lezingcweti ze-Pallava kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlobo zezakhiwo ezihlukile.
Mangudi Maruthanar’s counsel to the Pand: Iseluleko sikaMangudi Maruthanar enkosini yasePandya uNedunchezhiyan mayelana nokudlula kwazo zonke izinto, ngesithombe eside saseMadurai emini nasebusuku - eside kunawo wonke kuma-Idyll ayishumi.

Isithombe esijwayelekile sokudla: irayisi eliphekiwe eliphekwe nama-pulses, imifino futhi, lapho litholakala, inhlanzi noma inyama.

Modern Kanchipuram is widely known as a: I-Kanchipuram yesimanje yaziwa kabanzi njengedolobha lethempeli kanye nesikhungo esikhulu sokweluka usilika. Amathempeli alo angokomlando ayaqhubeka nokusebenza njengezindawo zokukhulekela, kuyilapho ama-sarees kasilika endabuko exhuma idolobha nefa lemisebenzi yezandla isikhathi eside. Izivakashi zingajabulela izakhiwo zayo zezenkolo, izimakethe zendawo kanye nemikhuba ephilayo yamasiko.
Modern Poompuhar is a coastal settlement: I-Modern Poompuhar iyindawo ehlala ogwini esifundeni saseMayiladuthurai, eTamil Nadu. Ugu, imiphakathi yendawo, izikhungo zamasiko kanye nophenyo lwemivubukulo kulondoloza ukuxhumana kwayo nomlando wasendulo wasolwandle waseTamil. Izinguquko zogu kanye nokuguguleka komhlabathi kuthinte isimo sezwe, futhi ukuhleleka okuphelele kwedolobha eliyitheku lasendulo akwaziwa ngokuqiniseka.
Modern Thanjavur remains a major cultura: I-Modern Thanjavur isalokhu iyindawo enkulu yamasiko e-Tamil Nadu. Ithempeli laseBrihadisvara liyaqhubeka nokuheha abakhulekeli, izazi-mlando, abadwebi bezakhiwo kanye nezivakashi. Idolobha laziwa nangemidwebo yaseThanjavur, umculo wakudala, umdanso, izithombe eziqoshiwe zethusi kanye nobuciko bendabuko.

Mullai represents pastoral and woodland: I-Mullai imele izindawo ezifuywayo nezamahlathi ezihambisana nokwelusa izinkomo kanye nempilo yabelusi. Ubisi nemikhiqizo yobisi kwakuyimithombo yokudla ebalulekile, kuyilapho okusanhlamvu nezinye izithako kwakutholakala ngokulima, ukushintshaniswa nokubuthwa kwendawo. Isithombe esijwayelekile sokudla: amabele noma irayisi elihambisana ne-curd noma ibhotela, nobisi neminye imikhiqizo yobisi njengokudla okubalulekile.
Munrurai Araiyanar’s four hundred verses: Amavesi angamakhulu amane kaMunrurai Araiyanar, ngalinye livala isaga.

Nakkeerar’s poem of the long, cold north: Inkondlo kaNakkeerar yomoya omude, obandayo wasenyakatho: indlovukazi ayilali esigodlweni sayo kuyilapho inkosi ingekho empini.

Nallathanar’s hundred verses, each namin: Amavesi ayikhulu kaNallathanar, ngalinye liqamba izinto ezintathu eziphulukisa ingqondo njengejinja eyomile, upelepele nopelepele omude ophilisa umzimba.

Nataraja dances within a circle of flame: U-Nataraja udansa phakathi kwendilinga yelangabi emhlabathini oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, unyawo olulodwa lutshalwe ku-Apasmara encane - ukungazi - olunye luphakanyiswe emzimbeni wakhe. The cave inscriptions at Mangulam near M: Imibhalo emigedeni eseMangulam eduze kwaseMadurai iphakathi kwamarekhodi amadala weTamil-Brahmi. Bakhuluma ngombusi wePandya uNedunchezhiyan kanye nezipho ezenzelwe izindela.

The eri system was a major part of tradi: Uhlelo lwe-eri lwaluyingxenye enkulu yokuphathwa kwamanzi endabuko eTamil Nadu. I-eri ithangi lokunisela lokuzenzela elenzelwe ukuqoqa nokugcina amanzi emvula nokugeleza kwamanzi. Phakathi neziphepho, amanzi ayenqwabelana ngemva kodonga lobumba. Amanzi agciniwe asekela ukutshalwa kwe-paddy nezinye izitshalo, kuyilapho imibhede yamathangi kanye nomhlaba ozungezile kwakha ingxenye yendawo yezolimo yedolobhana. I-eri yayingeyona nje indawo yokugcina amanzi. Kwakuyingxenye yohlelo olubanzi lwedolobhana olwaludinga ukuchithwa njalo, ukulungiswa nokuphathwa ngokuhlanganyela. Uma egcinwe kahle, amathangi asiza ukunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi ngokugeleza okungalawuleki futhi athuthukisa ukutholakala kwamanzi ngezikhathi ezomile.

The Kallanai, or Grand Anicut, across th: I-Kallanai, noma i-Grand Anicut, ngaphesheya kweKaveri - ngokwesiko ebizwa ngokuthi inkosi yamaChola uKarikala - yakhiwe ukuze ilawule futhi iguqule amanzi omfula abe yimigudu yokunisela. The Kanchipuram silk saree is one of the: I-Kanchipuram silk saree ingenye yezingubo zendabuko ezihlonishwa kakhulu zaseTamil Nadu. Isuka e-Kanchipuram, isikhungo sokweluka esinomlando, le saree idume ngendwangu yayo kasilika ecebile, umsebenzi we-zari oyinkimbinkimbi, imingcele ehlukile, namaphethini ayinkimbinkimbi. Imidwebo yendabuko ihlanganisa imibhoshongo yethempeli, amaphigogo, umango, izimbali, nemiklamo yejiyomethri. I-saree ilukwa kusetshenziswa intambo kasilika, enemicu ye-zari enombala wegolide noma wesiliva enezela ukunotha kokuhlobisa. I-Kanchipuram silk sarees ibamba indawo ebalulekile emishadweni yesiTamil, imikhosi yezenkolo, imikhosi, nezinye izikhathi ezikhethekile. Inqubo yokuluka idinga ikhono elikhulu, ikakhulukazi lapho ujoyina umzimba, umngcele, kanye ne-pallu kusetshenziswa amasu okuhlanganisa avamile. Umsebenzi wezandla wathuthukiswa ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane, futhi unyaka wawo owasungulwa wona awukaziwa ngokomlando. I-Kancheepuram Silk ithole ukuqashelwa kwe-Geographical Indication (GI) ngo-2005. Namuhla, i-saree imelela ifa lendwangu ye-Tamil Nadu, ubuciko obunamakhono, kanye nokuziphilisa okuqhubekayo kwemiphakathi yokweluka yendabuko.
The Kandangi saree is a traditional cott: I-Kandangi saree iyindwangu kakotini yendabuko ehlotshaniswa nesifunda sase-Chettinad, ikakhulukazi i-Karaikudi nezindawo ezingomakhelwane. Yaziwa ngamasheke ayo agqamile, imigqa, imingcele ehlukile, nemibala eqinile, ehlanganisa okubomvu, lwesinaphi, okuwolintshi, kanye nokunsundu komhlaba. Ngokwesiko, indwangu yayo yekotini eqinile yayifaneleka ukusetshenziswa njalo, ibonisa izidingo ezingokoqobo zezingubo zansuku zonke. I-Kandangi weaving imele ulwazi oluhlukile lobuhle kanye nezindwangu esifundeni sase-Chettinad. Amaphethini ayo kanye nenhlanganisela yemibala iyayihlukanisa kwamanye amasiko amaningi e-saree aseNingizimu Indian. Inqubo yokukhiqiza ihilela ukulungisa intambo, ukuhlela izintambo ku-loom, ukuluka indwangu, nokuqedela imingcele nokuqeda. Izinto zikaHulumeni ezenziwe ngezandla zichaza leli siko njengelikhona iminyaka engaphezu kwe-150, nakuba unyaka walo oqondile oqala ngalo uhlala ungaqiniseki. The Kaveri in spate below the Grand Anic: I-Kaveri ehamba ngaphansi kwe-Grand Anicut. Izimbongi zaseTamil zancoma izwe lamaChola njengezwe laseKaveri, elinobuhle obungakaze lwehluleke; i-Silappatakaram iyigubha njengezwe le-paddy elingenamkhawulo. I-anicut yaguqula leyo nzuzo yaba uhlelo oluphethwe, futhi i-delta yaba isitsha serayisi sezwe laseTamil.
The Koorainadu saree is associated with: I-Koorainadu saree ihlotshaniswa ne-Koorainadu eduze neMayiladuthurai ngesiTamil Nadu. Ixhumeke ikakhulukazi imvunulo yomshado yendabuko kanye nokubaluleka kwamasiko kwezindwangu emasikweni omshado wesiTamil. Izinhlobo zendabuko zihlanganisa izindwangu zikasilika nezikakotini, ezinemiklamo ehlukene nezinto ezisetshenziswa ngokuya ngesitayela nenjongo ethile. I-saree ibonisa indima yezingubo ezilukiweyo emikhosini ebalulekile yomndeni kanye nokudluliselwa kwamasiko endwangu phakathi kwezizukulwane. Ukubukeka kwayo, indwangu, kanye nezici zokuhlobisa zingahlukahluka, ngakho izibonelo ngazinye kufanele zibhalwe ngokuvumelana nokwakhiwa kwazo kwangempela kunokuthatha ngokuthi yonke i-Koorainadu saree ilandela umklamo ofanayo. Unyaka oqondile wemvelaphi yaleli siko awuqinisekiswanga ngokuqinile. I-Koorainadu sarees ihlala iyisihloko esibalulekile sokuhlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwezingubo, ubunikazi besifunda, ubuciko, kanye nempilo yemikhosi e-Tamil Nadu.
The Kovai Kora cotton saree is associate: I-Kovai Kora cotton saree ihlotshaniswa ne-Coimbatore kanye nesifunda esizungezile sokukhiqiza izindwangu. Yenziwe kusukela kukotini, yaziswa ngenxa yobuhle bayo obungaphansi, ukuthungwa okunethezekile, nemingcele yendabuko. Uma kuqhathaniswa namasaree kasilika ahlotshiswe kakhulu, izindwangu zikakotini zeKora ngokuvamile zigcizelela ukubukeka kwemvelo kukakotini, ukugqokwa okungokoqobo, kanye nemininingwane yedizayini ecashile. I-saree ikhombisa ukubaluleka kokutshala ukotini, ukukhiqizwa kwentambo, ukuluka, nokuhweba ngezindwangu eTamil Nadu. Ukukhiqiza i-handloom saree kudinga ukulungiswa ngokucophelela kwezintambo ze-warp ne-weft kanye nokusebenza okunekhono kwe-loom. I-Kora ukotini ifaneleka ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nokugqoka kwansuku zonke kanye nemibuthano ehlelekile. I-Kovai Kora Cotton ithole ukuqashelwa kwe-GI ngo-2008. Unyaka wayo oqondile wokusungula awusungulwa, kodwa isiko lihlala liyisibonelo esibalulekile sefa lezwe elihlukahlukene le-cotton-weaving.
The larger digitisation catalogued under: Ukufakwa kwedijithali okukhudlwana okufakwe kukhathalogi ngaphansi kwenombolo efanayo, 603 D: izithombe zamaqabunga ezingaphezu kwamakhulu ayisithupha zenqwaba lapho kugcinwa khona i-Kar Narpathu.
The Leiden plates record a Chola grant o: Amapuleti e-Leiden aqopha ukunikezwa kwe-Chola kwedolobhana ku-vihara yamaBuddha e-Nagapattinam, eyalwe ngu-Rajaraja I futhi yakhishwa ngaphansi kuka-Rajendra I. Manje agcinwe eLeiden, eNetherlands.
The literary image of ancient Tamil mari: Isithombe semibhalo sokuchuma kwe-Tamil yasendulo yasolwandle.
The long pillared cloister that encloses: I-cloister ende enezinsika ehlanganisa igceke lethempeli laseBrihadisvara, elinomugqa wama-lingams abekwe phansi kwawo. Izindonga zayo zazipendwe ngesikhathi samaNayak ngezigcawu ezijabulisayo - lapha ama-ganas ka-Shiva ane-pot-bellied, abalindi bakhe abadlalayo abadlalayo - ngaphansi kwebhande lamagama-ncazo wesi-Tamil. Ngemuva kwemidwebo enjalo yakamuva, emhubheni ezungeze i-sanctum, kukhona imidwebo yasethempelini yokuqala yeChola.
The longest of the Ten Idylls, by Mangud: Okude kunawo wonke kuma-Idyll ayishumi, kaMangudi Maruthanar, aqondiswe enkosini yasePandya uNedunchezhiyan. Ichaza idolobha elikhulu laseMadurai kusukela ekuseni kuze kube sebusuku futhi ikhumbuza inkosi ngobumnene ukuthi yonke inkazimulo yezwe iyadlula.
The lotus pool of Sittanavasal, the Pall: Ichibi le-lotus lika-Sittanavasal, unkulunkulukazi we-Pallava wasePanamalai, izithombe eziqoshiwe ze-Chola kanye nemidwebo yase-Nayak yeThempeli Elikhulu e-Thanjavur, kanye nemidwebo ye-Tanjore eqoshiwe.
The Madurai Sungudi saree is a tradition: I-Madurai Sungudi saree iyindwangu kakotini yendabuko ehlotshaniswa ne-Madurai, isikhungo somlando samasiko nezohwebo e-Tamil Nadu. Ihlukaniswa ngamaphethini ayo anamachashazi, imiklamo emibalabala, nezindlela ezivamile zokuhlanganisa uthayi nodayi noma zokuphikisa. Izingxenye ezincane zendwangu ziboshwe noma zivikelwe ngesikhathi sokudaya ukuze zenze amaphethini ahlukile lapho impahla ivuliwe. Izindwangu ze-Sungudi zihlonishwa ngokubukeka kwazo okukhangayo, indwangu kakotini engasindi, nokufaneleka kwezingubo zansuku zonke nezemikhosi. Lo msebenzi wezandla uhlanganisa ulwazi lokulungiswa kwendwangu, amasu okubopha, ukudaya, nokuqeda. Umsuka wayo ongokomlando awuboshelwe onyakeni wokuqala obhalwe ngokuvikelekile. UMadurai Sungudi uthole ukuqashelwa kwe-GI ngo-2005, evuma ukuhlangana kwayo nesifunda. Isiko libonisa ukuthi izingcweti ze-Tamil zathuthukisa kanjani imiklamo yendwangu ehlukile zisebenzisa amakhono akhethekile okudaya kanye nezinqubo zokukhiqiza ezisungulwe endaweni.
The masonry arches that now crown the an: Izindonga zamatshe manje ezithwesa umqhele wasendulo. Onjiniyela baseBrithani abafunda iKallanai ekhulwini leshumi nesishiyagalolunye bahlabeka umxhwele ngayo: USir Arthur Cotton wafunda ezisekelweni zayo ngaphambi kokwakha i-Upper Anicut ngaphesheya kwe-Kollidam ngo-1836, futhi uRichard Baird Smith wayincoma ngeminyaka yawo-1850 njengomsebenzi omangalisayo owawuthathe amakhulu eminyaka. Yibo abaqamba igama elithi "Grand Anicut".
The Meenakshi Amman Temple, historic str: IThempeli le-Meenakshi Amman, imigwaqo yomlando, amasiko enkolo, kanye nemikhuba eqhubekayo yemibhalo namasiko ixhuma i-Madurai yesimanje nomlando wayo omude.
The memorial hall to Karikal Chozhan at: Ihholo lesikhumbuzo likaKarikal Chozhan eKallanai, eliphakanyiswe nguHulumeni waseTamil Nadu. UKarikalan, iqhawe lePattinappalai kanye nePorunararruppadai, ukhunjulwa ngesiko lesiTamil njengenkosi eyabamba iKaveri. Kamuva izinkondlo zamaChola ezifana neKulothunga Cholan Ula, kanye nemibhalo yezizukulwane ezazithi ziphuma kuye, zimnikeza udumo ngokukhulisa amabhange amaKaveri.
The mini-map in the corner shows the who: Ibalazwe elincane ekhoneni libonisa yonke imnyuziyamu; umcibisholo obomvu nguwe, okhomba indlela obheke ngayo. Vula imephu egcwele (noma inkinobho Yemephu) bese ukhetha noma yiliphi ihholo noma igumbi ongavakashela lapho.
The monuments of Mamallapuram, carved ma: Izikhumbuzo zaseMamallapuram, eziqoshwe ikakhulukazi ngekhulu lesi-7 nelesi-8 CE, zifaka amathempeli emigede esikwe ngamadwala, ama-monolithic rathas, kanye neThempeli le-Shore elihlelekile. Leli qembu liyiNdawo Yamagugu Omhlaba ye-UNESCO.
The monuments themselves, with Pallava i: Amatshe esikhumbuzo ngokwawo, anemibhalo kaPallava neziqu zobukhosi eziqoshwe kuwo.
The most celebrated of the Seven Great P: Okugujwa kakhulu kwabasekeli Abayisikhombisa Abakhulu. Isiko lesiTamil limkhumbula enikeza eyakhe inqola ku-creeper ye-jasmine (mullai) eyayingenalutho lokukhuphuka - ukuphana okufinyelela ngalé kwabantu emhlabeni wemvelo. Ubungane bakhe nembongi uKapilar, ukuvikela kwakhe uParambu Nadu emakhosini amathathu athweswe umqhele, kanye nesililo samadodakazi akhe u-Angavai noSangavai (Purananuru 112) kugcinwa ezinkondlweni zeSangam; indaba yenqola ifundwa kangcono njengesiko lokubhala.
The mountains and the land around them,: Izintaba nezwe elizizungezile, phakathi kwamabili ngenkathi epholile. Unkulunkulu wawo uMurugan (Seyon), futhi imbali yawo i-irinji, eqhakaza kanye eminyakeni eyishumi nambili. Itimu yawo ithi punarthal, umhlangano oyimfihlo wezithandani. Abantu bakhona babutha uju, bagade amasimu amabele kumapholi futhi bazingele ehlathini.
The murasu is the great drum of Sangam l: I-murasu iyisigubhu esikhulu sezincwadi zeSangam, ezikhalela amakhosi, impi, izimemezelo zomphakathi nemikhosi - izwi layo ngokwalo laliwuphawu lwegunya lobukhosi. Izigubhu ezibizwa ngokuthi i-murasu cishe zahluka ngobukhulu, impahla kanye nokumiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngakho-ke asikho isigubhu sesimanje esifana ncamashi; ukwakhiwa kabusha kuwukuhumusha imibhalo.
The museum’s historical research guide t: Umhlahlandlela womlando wocwaningo lomnyuziyamu wokuluka ngesi-Tamil Nadu kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo kuze kube manje: umugqa wesikhathi, izinto zokwakha kanye nenqubo, ubufakazi bemibhalo ye-Sangam kanye nesayensi yemivubukulo, inkathi yenkathi ephakathi, yamakholoni nesimanje, kanye nemithombo yayo, ngesiNgisi.

The museum’s research guide to ancient T: Umhlahlandlela wokucwaninga wemnyuziyamu ekuhwebeni kwasendulo kwe-Tamil: umugqa wesikhathi kusukela ekushintshanisweni kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kuya kumanethiwekhi echweba enkathi ephakathi, kanye nomlando nobufakazi bamachweba ayisishiyagalolunye nezikhungo zokuhweba, uma kuqhathaniswa netafula lokuvala.
The nadaswaram is the great double-reed: I-nadaswaram iyinsimbi yomoya enemihlanga emibili yomculo wethempeli lesi-Tamil, ezwakala emikhosini, emishadweni nasemibuthanweni. Umzimba omude wokhuni onezimbobo zeminwe uphetha ngensimbi evuthayo; umhlanga nebhova kunikeza iphimbo lakho elinamandla, elithwalayo. Idinga ukulawula ukuphefumula nokuphimisa kahle, idlala ukuthuthukiswa kwe-classical okude, i-ragas nezingoma - ngokuvamile ngokubambisana ne-thavil.
The name seems to have been borne by mor: Leli gama kubukeka sengathi lifakwe izimbongi zesifazane ezingaphezu kweyodwa. Izinkondlo zikaSangam Avvaiyar ePurananuru, Akananuru, Kurunthogai naseNatrinai zikhuluma ngamakhosi, ukuphana nokufa; wayengumeluleki othembekile ku-Adhiyaman. Okwakudala kwezingane u-Aathichudi, u-Kondrai Vendhan kanye no-Nalvazhi ngeze-Avvaiyar yakamuva.
The Noyyal River region of Tamil Nadu pr: Isifunda soMfula i-Noyyal e-Tamil Nadu sinikeza esinye isibonelo sokuphathwa kwamanzi ngoxhaxha lwamathangi namashaneli ahlobene. Esikhundleni sokuncika kuphela ekugelezeni kwemifula okuqondile, imiphakathi yakha izinhlelo zokugcina ezisiza ukubamba nokusabalalisa amanzi atholakalayo. Amathangi akumanethiwekhi anjalo angaqoqa izimvula ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka kanye nokugeleza kwamanzi, akugcine ukuze kusetshenziswe kamuva kwezolimo. Ukuba wusizo kwazo kwakuncike ekuhlelweni kwendawo, isimo sezingongolo, umthamo wamashaneli kanye nesikhathi sokuna kwemvula. Lapho inakekelwa kahle, inethiwekhi exhunyiwe yasiza ukusabalalisa izinsiza zamanzi ezinomkhawulo ezindaweni eziningi. Uhlelo lwe-Noyyal River luyaziwa futhi emibhalweni yamagugu yamanzi aseNdiya. Ikhombisa ukuthi kungani ukuchelela ngokwendabuko kufanele kuqondwe njengenethiwekhi yezakhiwo ezihlobene esikhundleni sokuqoqwa kwamathangi angawodwa.
The objects of a Tamil home, the Kallana: Izinto zekhaya lesiTamil, i-Kallanai kanye namathangi esigodi, nokulima kusuka egejeni kuya ekuvuneni.
The objects of a traditional Tamil home: Izinto zekhaya lendabuko yesiTamil - izimbiza zobumba nezimbiza zokusanhlamvu, amatshe okugaya ama-ammi kanye ne-aattukkal, i-ural ne-ulakkai, izimbiza zamanzi, izibani zikawoyela, amacansi, izifeni, imibhede, obhasikidi namaleyidi - kanye nokudla kwansuku zonke okuphekwe ngazo: irayisi namabele, ama-pulses, i-koozh, i-buttermilk kanye nokudla kwamaqabunga.
The oldest surviving Tamil grammar, in t: Uhlelo lolimi lwesiTamil oludala kunazo zonke, ezincwadini ezintathu - lwezinhlamvu, zamagama, nezihloko (i-porul), lapho kubekwe khona ama-tinai amahlanu wezinkondlo.
The Pallava capital and a temple city of: Inhloko-dolobha yasePallava kanye nedolobha lokufunda lasethempelini, kuseyisikhungo sokukhulekela nokuluka usilika.
The palmyra palm provided several useful: Isundu se-palmyra sinikeze imikhiqizo eminingana ewusizo. Ubisi lwesundu lwalungadliwa lusha noma lucutshungulwe, kuyilapho ushukela wesundu kanye ne-palm jaggery kwakusetshenziswa njengoshukela. Imikhiqizo yesundu yayibaluleke kakhulu ezifundeni lapho isihlahla sasichichima futhi sakha ingxenye yokuphila kwendawo.
The pambai is a pair of drums played tog: I-pambai izigubhu ezidlalwa ndawonye, ​​amazwi azo aphansi naphakeme aqhathanisayo ashayela imidlalo yesintu, udwendwe nemikhosi yasemakhaya e-Tamil Nadu. Isiko layo eliphilayo libhalwe kangcono kunemvelaphi yalo, futhi umlando walo uyashintsha kusuka esifundeni kuya kwesinye kanye nomphakathi kuya emphakathini.
The Pancha Rathas are monolithic shrines: I-Pancha Rathas yizindawo zokukhulekela ze-monolithic ngayinye eqoshwe endaweni eyodwa, ebonisa uhla lwezinhlobo zezakhiwo zethempeli etsheni.
The Pandya capital on the Vaigai, closel: Inhloko-dolobha yasePandya eVaigai, isondelene kakhulu namasiko eTamil Sangam kanye nezinkondlo zakudala.
The parai is a Tamil frame drum: a circu: I-parai isigubhu sefreyimu yesi-Tamil: uhlaka oluyisiyingi olunolwelwesi olululiwe, olushaywa ngezigqi esigqi esinephethini. Sekuyisikhathi eside isebenzela izimemezelo, amasiko, imikhosi kanye nemingcwabo, futhi i-parai attam yanamuhla ijoyina isigubhu ukuze idanse. Umlando wayo futhi uphethe isigaba sesigaba esabandlulula abadlali abaningi bofuzo - futhi ngesiko lesiTamil namuhla i-parai idlalelwa ukugomela ubunikazi, isithunzi nokulingana.
The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea names: I-Periplus of the Erythraean Sea ibiza iTyndis phakathi kwamachweba ogu olusentshonalanga, endaweni yenkosi yamaChera, kanti izincwadi zesiTamil zikhumbula itheku elibizwa ngokuthi iTondi. Lapho imile khona akuqinisekwanga: I-Tanur, i-Ponnani kanye ne-Kadalundi zonke zihlongozwa, futhi idolobhana lesimanje i-Thondi ogwini oluseningizimu-mpumalanga ye-Tamil Nadu alikwazi ukuvele likhonjwe ngazo zonke izithenjwa zasendulo. I-Tyndis iqondwa kangcono ngendawo yayo phakathi kwamachweba aseMalabar nezindlela ezimaphakathi nezwe ezingemuva kwawo.
The ports and trading centres of ancient: Amachweba nezikhungo zokuhweba zaseTamilkam yasendulo - iPuhar ne-Arikamedu ogwini olusempumalanga, i-Korkai ne-Alagankulam ezweni lasePandya, iMuziris neTyndis entshonalanga, ne-Uraiyur, Karur ne-Kodumanal phakathi nezwe - ngayinye ebhukwini lezithombe zokumbiwa kwayo.
The pullanguzhal, the bamboo flute, is b: I-pullanguzhal, umtshingo woqalo, ivuthelwa endaweni evulekile kuyilapho iminwe ivala futhi iveze izimbobo zayo. Ezinkondlweni zeSangam umtshingo ungoka-mullai, indawo yokwelusa abelusi namahlathi; namuhla izwakala emculweni wesintu, wokukhulekela nowakudala ngokufanayo. Umtshingo wezinkondlo uyindikimba yemibhalo, nokho - hhayi ubufakazi bokuthi yonke imitshingo yasendulo yayiyinsimbi efanayo.
The red arrow is you, pointing where you: Umcibisholo obomvu nguwe, okhomba lapho obheke khona.
The region’s archaeological evidence, li: Ubufakazi bemivubukulo besifunda, izinkomba zemibhalo, indawo engaselugwini kanye nemibukiso yamasiko kusiza izivakashi ziqonde ukubaluleka kwaso ngokomlando.
The reverse of a coin naming Uttama Chol: Ukuhlehla kohlamvu lwemali oluqanjwe ngo-Uttama Chola (c. 970–985 CE), izinhlamvu zakhe zesiliva ziphakathi kwezindaba zokuqala ze-Chola zokuphatha igama lenkosi - lapha embhalweni weGrantha osetshenziselwa isi-Sanskrit ezweni lesiTamil.
The reverse of a Setu coin, where the le: Ukuhlehla kohlamvu lwemali lwe-Setu, lapho kubhalwe khona inganekwane ethi “Setu”. Ukufunda imibhalo ebusweni bobubili bohlamvu lwemali - okuphambene nokuhlehlayo - yindlela ama-numismatists ahlonza ngayo ukuthi ubani oyikhiphe futhi nini.
The revived Pandya kingdom continued to: Umbuso we-Pandya ovuselelwe waqhubeka nokusebenzisa uphawu lwezinhlanzi, ngokuvamile ubonisa izinhlanzi ezimbili, ngezinye izikhathi ngentonga noma isibani.
The ripe paddy is cut by hand with sickl: I-paddy evuthiwe isikwa ngesandla ngamasikela, bese iyabhulwa ukuze kuhlukaniswe okusanhlamvu nezinhlanga futhi kuseliwe ukuze kususwe amakhoba. Isivuno sasondla amakhaya nezimakethe, futhi imali engenayo yomhlaba evela kukho yasekela amandla abusayo - ezolimo zazisekela ukufuywa kwezinkomo, ukugaywa kokusanhlamvu, ezokuthutha kanye nokuhweba eduze kwakho.
The river that fed the Chola kingdom’s a: Umfula owawuphakela ezolimo zombuso wamaChola kanye nezinkondlo zawo zenala.
The rock-cut and structural monuments of: Izikhumbuzo ze-rock-cut kanye nezakhiwo ze-Mamallapuram eziqoshwe ngaphansi kwe-Pallavas, kuhlanganise nokukhululeka okukhulu kanye namaRatha amahlanu.
The rock-cut caves, sculptural reliefs,: Imigede ye-rock-cut, i-sculptural reliefs, i-rathas ye-monolithic namathempeli esakhiwo inikeza ubufakazi obuqondile bempumelelo yobuciko be-Pallava.
The Salem silk saree is associated with: I-Salem silk saree ihlotshaniswa ne-Salem, isifunda esibalulekile esikhiqiza izindwangu eTamil Nadu. Elukwe kusetshenziswa intambo kasilika, lawa ma-saree anemibala eyahlukene, imiklamo yemingcele, namaphethini okuhlobisa. Ukubukeka kwabo kungasukela kumiklamo elula nenhle kuye kwezinezindwangu ezihloselwe imishado, imikhosi, nezinye izikhathi ezikhethekile. Ifa lendwangu ye-Salem lixhunywe ekuthuthukisweni okubanzi kokukhiqizwa kukasilika, ukuluka, nezimakethe zendwangu yokuhweba eTamil Nadu. Umsebenzi wezandla udinga umsebenzi onekhono ekulungiseni intambo, umise indwangu yokuluka, ulondoloze ukushuba okungaguquki kokweluka, nokuqeda indwangu. I-Salem Silk yathola ukuqashelwa kwe-GI ngo-2007, ivuma ngokusemthethweni ubunikazi bayo besifunda. Lolu suku lokubhalisa alubonisi ukuthi isiko laqala nini. Namuhla, usilika we-Salem usalokhu uyingxenye yefa lendwangu ye-Tamil Nadu ehlukahlukene futhi ubonisa ukubaluleka kwezikhungo zokuluka zesifunda ekugcineni amakhono endabuko kanye nokusekela izimpilo zamangcweti.

The saree traditions of Tamil Nadu — the: Amasiko e-saree e-Tamil Nadu - amasilika e-Kanchipuram, e-Arani, e-Thirubuvanam nase-Salem, ukotini odayiwe we-Madurai Sungudi, ukotini we-Kovai Kora, amasheke anesibindi e-Chettinad Kandangi, nama-saries omshado ka-Koorainadu - ngayinye ebhukwini lezithombe.
The sea and the shore, at dusk in every: Ulwandle nogu, lapho kuhwalala ngaso sonke isikhathi sonyaka. Unkulunkulu wawo nguVarunan, inkosi yamanzi, futhi imbali yawo i-blue water-lily (neithal). Itimu yayo ithi irangal - i-pining ekhathazekile njengoba iqhawekazi libuka ulwandle isikebhe sesithandwa salo. Abantu bakhona bayadoba, basule izinhlanzi zabo futhi benze usawoti emapanini asogwini.
The sea routes that joined the Tamil coa: Imizila yasolwandle ejoyine ugu lwaseTamil eya oLwandle Olubomvu, iMedithera kanye neNingizimu-mpumalanga ye-Asia, ukwakhiwa kwamachweba - amachweba, imithombo nezindawo zezitini - nezimbiza, izitsha zobumba nezimpahla ezazihamba phakathi kwazo - nge-Adichanallur, indawo yokungcwaba ye-Iron Age esigodini saseThamirabarani, endaweni ethule nefilimu.
The secret of Kallanai’s endurance: clay: Imfihlo yokukhuthazela kukaKallanai: ubumba nodaka oluhle oluthwalwa izikhukhula lwasebenza ezikhaleni phakathi kwamatshe futhi lwavalwa. Umfula wasiza ekwakheni idamu lawo, futhi zonke izikhukhula ezazishiya udaka olusha zazivuselela uphawu. Ngokwesiko lesi sithiyo setshe nobumba sesimile emfuleni ophilayo iminyaka ecela ezinkulungwaneni ezimbili.
The shore at Poompuhar in Mayiladuthurai: Ugu lwasePoompuhar esifundeni saseMayiladuthurai, lapho uguquko olusogwini kanye nokuguguleka kwezindlu kuye kwalungisa kabusha isimo sechweba lasendulo.
The shore at Poompuhar today, near the m: Ugu ePoompuhar namuhla, eduze nomlomo weKaveri, lapho ichweba lakuqala laseChola lasePuhar kwake kwaba khona. Izinhlolovo ezingaphansi kwamanzi zithole ukwakhiwa kwamatshe kulolu gu; ukuthi idolobha lasendulo lafinyelela kude kangakanani, nokuthi ugu lwashintsha kanjani, kusacutshungulwa.
The Shore Temple and its grounds beside: IThempeli Lasogwini kanye nenkundla yalo eseceleni kolwandle, ibonakala phezulu.
The Shore Temple on the Coromandel Coast: IThempeli Lasogwini eCoromandel Coast, ingxenye yeQembu Lezikhumbuzo eMahabalipuram, iNdawo Yamagugu Omhlaba ye-UNESCO.
The shortest of the Ten Idylls, by Nappu: Emfishane kuma-Idyll ayishumi, kaNapputanar. Njengoba isendaweni yehlathi (mullai) phakathi nenkathi yemvula, ibonisa inkosikazi elinde ngesineke umyeni wayo ukuba abuye empini.
The signature pottery of the Tamil Iron: Ubumba olusayiniwe lwe-Tamil Iron Age luyi-ware emnyama nebomvu: ebomvu ngaphandle, emnyama ecwebezelayo ngaphakathi nasonqenqemeni. Ababumbi bakufeza lokhu ngokudubula izitsha zibheke phansi, ukuze ingxenye evikelwe emoyeni ibe mnyama. Izimbiza eziningi ezinjalo zinezimpawu noma imidwebo eklwetshiwe odakeni, futhi kusukela esikhathini sokuqala somlando kuqhubeke, amagama abhalwe ngesiTamil-Brahmi - umbhalo weTamil omdala kakhulu - eKeeladi, Kodumanal, Arikamedu futhi kude njengaseSri Lanka, Thailand kanye nogu loLwandle Olubomvu eGibhithe.
The surviving halls, pillars, arches and: Amahholo asekhona, izinsika, amakhothamo namagceke agcina izibonelo ezibalulekile zezakhiwo zaseNayak, nakuba yonke inkimbinkimbi yasekuqaleni ingasekho.
The temple complex from above, within th: Isakhiwo sethempeli esivela phezulu, ngaphakathi kwedolobha lesimanje laseThanjavur.
The temple enclosure seen from directly: Indawo ebiyelwe ethempelini ebonwa ngokuqondile phezulu: i-vimana, i-mandapa ende, izindawo ezingcwele ezizungeze igceke kanye nebhubesi eliyindilinga-libheke kahle eduze nomnyango.
The temple from the air, its gopurams ri: Ithempeli elivela emoyeni, ama-gopuram alo akhuphuka emigwaqweni yedolobha lanamuhla elakhula elizungezile.
The temple, sculptural details, inscript: Ithempeli, imininingwane eqoshiwe, imibhalo kanye nezinsalela zemivubukulo kugcina ubufakazi bokubaluleka kombuso nenkolo yalesi siza.
The temple’s own inscriptions record its: Imibhalo yethempeli uqobo irekhoda isakhiwo salo, iminikelo kanye nabasebenzi ngokuningiliziwe.
The Ten Idylls and the Eight Anthologies: I-Ten Idyll kanye ne-Eight Anthologies - izinkondlo zokuqala zesi-Tamil, ezinhlelweni ze-CICT.
The Thamirabarani — known in Tamil as th: I-Thamirabarani - eyaziwa ngesiTamil ngokuthi i-Porunai - igeleza idlule indunduma yokungcwaba isendleleni eya eGulf of Mannar. Ezansi nomfula kwakuneKorkai, itheku lasePandya elidume ngamaparele alo; njengoba ifilimu iphawula, abantu bakulesi sigodi babekwazi ukufinyelela olwandle, nezindlela ezingalé kwalo, ngendlela yomfula. Umfula wanikeza isigodi amasimu avundile, amanzi kanye nomgwaqo oya ogwini.
The thavil, closely tied to the Thanjavu: I-thavil, eboshwe eduze nesifunda sase-Thanjavur, isigubhu esimise okomphongolo esinekhanda ekugcineni komunye nomunye, sidlalwa ngesandla esisodwa ekhanda elilodwa nenduku emfushane kwenye. Ekuhlanganisweni kwe-nadaswaram kwenza okungaphezulu kakhulu kokugcina isikhathi: abadlali abanekhono baphendula ingoma ngokushintshashintsha kwesigqi namandla, ngokuzwakalayo ngokwanele udwendwe lwangaphandle kanye nemibuthano emikhulu yasethempelini.
The Thirubuvanam silk saree originates f: I-Thirubuvanam silk saree ivela e-Thirubuvanam esifundeni sase-Thanjavur e-Tamil Nadu. Imele isiko elikhethekile lokweluka usilika lapho izingcweti zenza izindwangu zikasilika ezimibalabala ezihlotshiswe ngemingcele elukiwe kanye nemifanekiso yendabuko. Ngokuya ngomklamo, ama-saree angase afake amaphethini ayinkimbinkimbi, imibala ehlukile, nezinto zokuhlobisa ezifanele izingubo zemikhosi nezemikhosi. Isiko libonisa ubudlelwano obude besifunda nobungcweti bezindwangu kanye nokudluliswa kolwazi lokuluka ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-silika ye-saree kudinga ubuchwepheshe ekulungiseni izintambo, ukusebenza kwe-loom, ukwakheka kwephethini, nokuqedwa kwendwangu. Nakuba unyaka oqondile wemvelaphi ungakasungulwa, i-Thirubuvanam iseyigama lesifunda elibalulekile efa le-Tamil Nadu lokuluka usilika. Ama-saree awo abonisa ukuthi izikhungo zokweluka ezihlukene zathuthukisa kanjani izitayela ezihlukile nesithunzi ngenkathi zinikela emlandweni obanzi wezindwangu zaseNingizimu Indian.
The Thirukkural by Thiruvalluvar: 1,330: The Thirukkural by Thiruvalluvar: 1,330 imigqa emibili couplets ezahlukweni 133, ihlukaniswe yaba izincwadi ezintathu - Virtue (Aram), Wealth (Porul), kanye Love (Inbam). Ihunyushelwe ezilimini eziningi zomhlaba.
The Thirukkural could not be opened just: I-Thirukkural ayikwazanga ukuvulwa njengamanje. Sicela uvale ukuskrola bese uzama futhi.
The three crowned kings of the Tamil lan: Amakhosi amathathu athweswe imiqhele ezwe lamaTamil ngalinye lalinomfanekiso, futhi izinhlamvu zawo zemali zaziphethe: ingwe yamaChola, izinhlanzi zamaPandya, nomnsalo wamaChera. Fundani ndawonye, ​​lezi zimpawu zitshela umlando wezepolitiki - lapho uhlamvu lwemali lwe-Chola lukhombisa ingwe ezungezwe inhlanzi yePandya kanye nomnsalo weChera, imemezela amandla enkosi yamaChola phezu kwezimbangi zayo.
The Tirukkural contains 1,330 couplets a: I-Tirukkural iqukethe imibhangqwana engu-1,330 ehlelwe yaba izahluko ezingu-133. Ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezintathu: Ubuhle, Ingcebo kanye Nothando. Lo msebenzi udingida ukuziphatha komuntu siqu, impilo yomndeni, ubungane, imfundo, ukubusa, ubulungisa kanye nozwelo.
The Tirukkural has been translated into: I-Tirukkural ihunyushelwe ezilimini eziningi, okuvumela imibono kaThiruvalluvar ukuthi ifinyelele abafundi ngale kwemingcele yezincwadi zesiTamil.
The Tiruvalangadu plates of Rajendra I a: Amapuleti e-Tiruvalangadu ka-Rajendra I kanye namapuleti e-Anbil e-Sundara Chola ayimithombo emikhulu yohlu lozalo nomlando wobukhosi bakwaChola.
The Tolkappiyam by Tolkappiyar is the ol: I-Tolkappiyam ka-Tolkappiyar iwuhlelo lolimi lwesiTamil oludala kunayo yonke. Izincwadi zayo ezintathu zihlanganisa izinhlamvu nemisindo (Ezhuthu), amagama (Sol), kanye nendaba yokuphila nezinkondlo (Porul).
The udukkai is a small hourglass-shaped: I-udukkai iyisigubhu esincane esimise okwe-hourglass, amakhanda ayo amabili ahlanganiswe izintambo ezicindezelayo; ukukhama izintambo kungashintsha iphimbo. Iphethwe ngesinye isandla futhi ishaywa ngesinye, ihambisana nezingoma zokuzinikela, izindaba zabantu kanye namakhonsathi - isikhumbuzo sokuthi ukushaywa, ukuzinikela kanye nokusebenza komlomo kusondelene kangakanani.
The ural and ulakkai were used to pound: I-ural ne-ulakkai yayisetshenziselwa ukugxoba irayisi, amabele, okusanhlamvu nezinongo. I-ural yayiwumkhumbi oqinile, ngokuvamile owawenziwa ngokhuni noma ngamatshe, kuyilapho i-ulakkai yayiyithuluzi elide lokubhoboza. Ndawonye, ​​basiza ukususa amakhoba, ukuhlephula okusanhlamvu nokulungisa izithako zokupheka. Amathuluzi aphinde abonise umzamo womzimba kanye nomsebenzi owabiwe ohilelekile ekulungiseni ukudla kwendabuko.
The veenai (Saraswati veena) is one of t: I-veenai (i-Saraswati veena) ingenye yezinsimbi eziyinhloko zomculo wasendulo waseNingizimu Indian: i-resonator enkulu yokhuni, intamo ende enyakazekile, izintambo nezikhonkwane zokulungisa, ngokuvamile ezine-resonator yesibili. Ukucindezela nokuslayida izintambo ngokumelene nama-frets kunikeza umculo we-Carnatic imihlobiso yawo emihle. Ehlotshaniswa noSaraswati, unkulunkulukazi wokufunda, kufanele ahlukaniswe ne-yazh yasendulo - efana nendima, kodwa hhayi inzalo yayo eqondile.
The walls of the Brihadeeswarar temple c: Izindonga zethempeli laseBrihadeeswarar zinemibhalo emide ye-Rajaraja I efaka ohlwini lwezipho, izisebenzi zethempeli, amagugu, nezipho - irekhodi elimangalisayo lethempeli njengesikhungo.
The wooden plough, often drawn by cattle: Igeja lokhuni, elivame ukudonswa izinkomo noma izinyathi, lalisetshenziselwa ukuxegisa nokulungisa indawo yokulima ukuze kutshalwe kuyo. Ngamathuluzi ezandla okutshala nokuhlakula, amasikela okuvuna, kanye nokubhula nokwela ukuze kuhlanzwe okusanhlamvu, kwakungokweqoqo lamathuluzi imiphakathi yabalimi eyayiwajwayelanisa nenhlabathi nezitshalo zayo futhi idluliselwa kwesinye isizukulwane iye kwesinye.
The woodland and pastures, in the evenin: Ihlathi namadlelo, kusihlwa ngenkathi yemvula. Unkulunkulu wawo nguMayon (Thirumal), futhi imbali yawo i-jasmine (mullai). Itimu yawo ithi iruthal - ukulinda ngesineke, njengoba iqhawekazi lilinda umyeni walo ukuthi abuye ngaphambi kwezimvula. Abantu bakhona bangabelusi abaluse izinkomo futhi bakha ukhukhamba nebhotela.
The works that arrange their verses land: Imisebenzi ehlela amavesi awo ngokwendawo ngokuma kwezwe - i-Ainkurunuru, i-Aintinai Aimpathu ne-Ezhupathu, i-Tinaimozhi Aimpathu, i-Tinaimalai Nurraimpathu kanye ne-Kainnilai - ezixukwini zamaqabunga esundu lapho akopishwa khona.
The world-famous Chola bronzes: how they: Ama-bronze e-Chola adumile emhlabeni wonke: ayenziwa kanjani indlela ye-wax elahlekile, isithombe se-Nataraja, kanye nobuciko obuphilayo be-Swamimalai.
The yazh is one of the most distinctive: I-yazh ingelinye lamathuluzi ahluke kakhulu ezincwadini zesi-Tamil zasendulo: insimbi yocingo ehlutshiwe, ngobubanzi njengehabhu eline-arched. I-Sangam isebenza njengePerumpanatrupadai, kanye neSilappatikaram, ichaza, futhi ingeye-panar, amabhadi ajoyine izinkondlo emculweni. Izazi zisho amafomu amaningana - i-periyazh, i-siriyazh, i-sakota yazh ne-vil yazh - okwakhiwa kwayo okuqondile imibhalo kungavezi ngokugcwele, ngakho-ke noma iyiphi i-yazh ebonwa namuhla iwukwakhiwa kabusha. Kuyithuluzi ngokwalo, hhayi nje i-veenai yakuqala.
These are food traditions associated wit: Lawa amasiko okudla ahlotshaniswa nezindawo nemiphakathi yezincwadi ze-Sangam, hhayi amamenyu angashintshi alandelwa yiwo wonke umuntu. Obekudla abantu bekuhluka ngokwenkathi, umphakathi, isizini nohwebo. Izithombe ziyimifanekiso yesimanjemanje yokudla okuchazwa yimibhalo, hhayi izitsha zasendulo.
Thirugnanasambandar, the 7th-century chi: U-Thirugnanasambandar, ongcwele wengane wekhulu lesi-7, omunye wamaShaiva Nayanmars amakhulu amahubo akhe avula i-Tevaram. Ama-bronze e-Chola ambonisa njengomfana omncane edansa ejabulile, umunwe wakhe wokukhomba uphakamisele kuShiva, owathi - indaba - wayemnike ubisi lokuhlakanipha oluvela ebeleni likaParvati.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace represents the a: I-Thirumalai Nayak Palace imele ubukhazikhazi bezakhiwo, isiko lasebukhosini kanye nomlando wezepolitiki wenkathi yeMadurai Nayak.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace was constructed: I-Thirumalai Nayak Palace yakhiwa ngekhulu leshumi nesikhombisa ngesikhathi sokubusa kweNkosi uThirumalai Nayak yobukhosi baseMadurai Nayak. Lesi sigodlo sasiyindawo yokuhlala yasebukhosini nesikhungo sempilo yasebukhosini. Ukwakhiwa kwayo kuhlanganisa izinsika ezibekayo, amahholo abanzi, izici zokuhlobisa namathonya ahlobene nenkathi ye-Nayak. Ukulandisa okungokomlando kubonisa ukuthi isakhiwo sokuqala sesigodlo sasisikhulu kunezingxenye ezisekhona namuhla.
Thirumurugatrupadai, Porunaratrupadai, S: Thirumurugatrupadai, Porunaratrupadai, Sirupanatrupadai, Perumpanatrupadai, Mullaippattu, Maduraikkanchi, Nedunalvadai, Kurinjippattu, Pattinappalai, and Malaipadukadam. Lezi zinkondlo ezinde zihlanganisa "izinkondlo zomhlahlandlela" (atrupadai), lapho ibhadi eyodwa iqondisa enye kumphathi ophanayo.
Thiruvalluvar is celebrated as one of th: I-Thiruvalluvar igujwa njengenye yezimbongi ezinkulu kakhulu ezincwadini zesiTamil. Ngokwesiko uhlonishwa ngokuqamba i-Tirukkural, umsebenzi odumile wesiTamil ohlola izici ezintathu ezinkulu zokuphila komuntu: ubuhle, ingcebo nothando.
Thiruvalluvar occupies an important plac: I-Thiruvalluvar ithatha indawo ebalulekile kumagugu ezincwadi zesiTamil namasiko. Isithombe esiyisikhumbuzo eKanyakumari naseValluvar Kottam e-Chennai siphakathi kwezikhumbuzo ezibalulekile ezinikezelwe kuye.
Thiruvalluvar’s 1330 couplets on virtue,: Imibhangqwana ka-Thiruvalluvar engu-1330 mayelana nobuhle, ingcebo nothando, ikopishwe ngokuhlaziya kwekhulu leshumi nantathu likaParimelazhagar, okufundwe kakhulu kumazwana asendulo.
Thiruvalluvar’s teachings encourage peop: Izimfundiso zikaThiruvalluvar zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokwethembeka, baphathe abanye ngomusa futhi benze ngobulungisa. This manuscript could not be opened just: Lo mbhalo wesandla awukwazanga ukuvulwa njengamanje. Sicela ubuyele emuva bese uzama futhi.

To prepare definitive editions of the fo: Ukulungiselela izinguqulo eziqondile zemibhalo yakudala engamashumi amane nanye yesiTamil.

Izivakashi zingahlola izikhumbuzo zayo zasendulo, eziqoshiwe zamatshe, amathempeli kanye nezwe elingasogwini. IQembu Lezikhumbuzo eMahabalipuram liqashelwa njengeNdawo Yamagugu Omhlaba ye-UNESCO.
Today, the palace is a prominent heritag: Namuhla, lesi sigodlo siyindawo evelele yamagugu eMadurai. Today, the principal surviving landmark: Namuhla, uphawu oluyinhloko olusindile yiThempeli laseGangaikondacholeeswaram. Trade went on, but its places and partne: Ukuhweba kwaqhubeka, kodwa izindawo zayo kanye nozakwethu bashintsha: ukwehla kwechweba elilodwa akuzange kube ukuphela kohambo lwasolwandle lwaseTamil. Traditional author of Silappathikaram, t: Umbhali wendabuko we-Silappathikaram, I-Tale of the Anklet - indaba ka-Kannagi no-Kovalan, ehamba e-Puhar, e-Madurai naseVanchi, kanye nokuhlolwa okuseshwayo kobulungiswa nobukhosi. Isiko limenza inkosana yamaChera, umfowabo kaSenguttuvan, owalahla isihlalo sobukhosi; lokhu akukwazi ukuqinisekiswa ngokuzimele.
Traditional beverages included buttermil: Iziphuzo zendabuko zazihlanganisa ibhotela neziphuzo ezilungiselelwe izithako ezitholakala endaweni. Ezifundeni ezitshala i-palmyra, kwakudliwa ubisi olusha lwesundu, olubizwa ngokuthi i-padaneer. Iziphuzo ezibilisiweyo bezikhona kwezinye izimo zomlando, kodwa izithako zazo nokusetshenziswa kwazo kwakwehluka ngokomphakathi nesikhathi.
Traditional Tamil agriculture relied on: Ezolimo zomdabu zaseTamil zithembele kumathuluzi aklanyelwe ukulungisa umhlabathi, ukuhlwanyela imbewu, ukususa ukhula, ukuvuna izitshalo, nokucubungula okusanhlamvu. Igeja lokhuni, elivame ukudonswa izinkomo noma izinyathi, lalisetshenziselwa ukuxegisa nokulungisa indawo yokulima. Amathuluzi ezandla ayesiza abalimi ukuba benze umsebenzi wokutshala nowokulungisa, kuyilapho amasikela ayesetshenziselwa ukuvuna izitshalo. Ngemva kokuvuna, okusanhlamvu kwakuhlukaniswa nezinhlanga ngokubhulwa futhi kuhlanzwe ngokwela. Imishini evamile yokuphakamisa amanzi yasiza abalimi ukuba balethe amanzi avela emithonjeni, emachibini nasemathangeni baye emasimini abo. Amathuluzi anembile nezindlela zahlukahluka kuye ngesilimo, isifunda, nesikhathi somlando. Lezi zinsiza zibonisa indlela imiphakathi elimayo eyakha ngayo ubuchwepheshe obusebenzayo obuhambisana nezimo zendawo futhi yadlulisela ulwazi lwezolimo kusuka kwesinye isizukulwane kuya kwesinye.
Traditionally the author of the Tholkapp: Ngokwesiko umbhali we-Tholkappiyam, uhlelo lolimi lwesiTamil oludala kunawo wonke olusekhona, ezingxenyeni ezintathu - Ezhuthu (izinhlamvu), i-Sol (amagama) kanye ne-Porul (indaba), lapho kubekwe khona ukuhlukaniswa kwe-kam ne-puram kanye nezindawo thinai zezinkondlo zasendulo. Usuku nobunikazi bayo kusaxoxwa ngazo.
Izinhlobo ezimbili zobufakazi zihlangana kuleli gumbi. Ku-Vel Pari kanye no-Karikala Cholan, kanye ne-Kannagi, iqhawekazi lika-Silappathikaram, sincike ezinkondlweni ze-Sangam ne-epic, ezicebile ngenkumbulo kodwa hhayi amarekhodi anamuhla. Okwama-Chola enkathi ephakathi - uSembiyan Mahadevi, u-Rajaraja I kanye no-Rajendra I - imibhalo esezindongeni zethempeli kanye nemikhankaso yamapuleti ethusi erekhoda, izipho kanye nokuphatha ngokuningiliziwe.
Under the Nayaks of Thanjavur and Madura: Ngaphansi kwamaNayaks aseThanjavur naseMadurai (ikhulu le-16-18), izindonga nophahla lwethempeli kuvutha okuphuzi, okubomvu nokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka: onkulunkulu abafakwe ngamakhethini apendwe namagoda ezimbali, ama-epics ashiwo ngamabhande amade. Kusukela kulesi siko lenkantolo, kwaqhutshekwa ngababusi baseMaratha baseThanjavur, kwafika umdwebo weTanjore - iphaneli yokhuni nendwangu, izibalo zayo ziphakanyiswe ngoshoki nenhlaka, embozwe ngeqabunga legolide futhi ibekwe ngengilazi noma amatshe ayigugu. Onkulunkulu bahlezi ngaphansi kwamakhothamo, abanobuso obuyindilinga namehlo amakhulu; igolide libamba isibani endlini yethempeli. Ubuciko zisaqhutshwa e-Thanjavur namuhla.
Under Vijayanagara and the Nayakas, smal: Ngaphansi kwe-Vijayanagara kanye ne-Nayakas, ama-pagoda amancane egolide nama-fanam asakaza kabanzi kulo lonke izwe lesi-Tamil, ebonisa onkulunkulu, imibhangqwana yaphezulu, nezilwane.

Uraiyur, in present-day Tiruchirappalli,: I-Uraiyur, e-Tiruchirappalli yanamuhla, yayiyinhloko-dolobha ephakathi nezwe yamaCholas okuqala - hhayi ichweba. Ama-akhawunti e-Sangam-age ayihlobanisa nezindwangu ezinhle; indwangu ayivami ukuba isinde emhlabathini, ngakho izincwadi nomlando wesifunda unendaba yayo enkulu. I-Uraiyur ibonisa ukuthi ukukhiqiza phakathi nezwe kanye nokuphatha kwasebukhosini kondla kanjani izimakethe zasogwini, nakuba umthamo nezindawo zokuhwebelana kwakho kungenakulinganiswa ngokunembile.
Vel Pari and Karikala Cholan of the Sang: U-Vel Pari no-Karikala Cholan benkathi ye-Sangam, i-Kannagi ye-epic, kanye nenkathi ephakathi u-Cholas Sembiyan Mahadevi, u-Rajaraja I no-Rajendra I.
Venkateswara, Vishnu as the lord of the: UVenkateswara, uVishnu njengenkosi yamagquma aseTirumala, eboniswe emi njengasendaweni yakhe engcwele edumile, embozwe ngamatshe ayigugu nemihlobiso. Emidwebeni yaseTanjore isithombe sakhe singesinye sezicebe kakhulu ngegolide namatshe, sinanela ubukhazikhazi ahlotshiswe ngabo eTirupati.
Verses in praise of the three crowned ki: Amavesi okudumisa amakhosi amathathu athweswe imiqhele - uChera, uChola noPandya; kwezingamakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye izithembiso zesihloko, cishe eziyikhulu zisaphila.
Vilambi Naganar’s hundred verses, each s: Amavesi ayikhulu kaVilambi Naganar, ngalinye libeka amagugu amane okufundisa ngokuziphatha ngakunye.
Vinayaka enthroned beneath a gilded arch: UVinayaka ubekwe esihlalweni sobukhosi ngaphansi kwekhothamo elikhazimulayo, i-halo ebomvu ngemuva kwakhe, igundane lakhe kanye nesitsha samaswidi ezinyaweni zakhe. IManakula Vinayagar yiGanesha yethempeli elidumile ePuducherry. Ikhothamo, umqhele kanye nemihlobiso iphakanyiswe ngoshoki nenhlaka, embozwe ngeqabunga legolide futhi isethwe ngamatshe anemibala - inqubo yesiginesha yomdwebo we-Tanjore.
Vinayaka seated at ease on a gilded thro: UVinayaka uhlezi ngokukhululeka esihlalweni esikhazimulayo, umboko wakhe ugoqe ubheke kuswidi, ebambe ukhandi nesithiyo, negundane lakhe kanye nesitsha se-modakam phansi esibomvu. Ngokumelene nomhlabathi omnyama amakhothamo aphakeme, anamaqabunga egolide, imihlobiso nemihlobiso yezimbali kugqama njengokungathi kuqoshwe - umphumela abadwebi baseTanjore ababefuna izithombe ezihloselwe ukukhulekelwa ekhaya.
Vinayaka, remover of obstacles, who is h: U-Vinayaka, osusa izithiyo, ohlonishwa kuqala ngaphambi kwanoma yimuphi umsebenzi. Abadwebi be-Tanjore bammise phakathi nendawo ngaphansi kwekhothamo, enobuso obuyindilinga, obunjengobengane, futhi bakhe umqhele wakhe namatshe ayigugu nge-gesso ephakanyisiwe embozwe ngeqabunga legolide namatshe anombala.
Vishnu standing, four-armed, holding his: UVishnu emi, ehlome kane, ephethe i-discus yakhe ne-conch ngezandla zakhe ezingenhla. Amakhosi akwaPallava ayengabakhi abakhulu babo bobabili uShiva noVishnu, futhi lesi sithombe esizolile, esingaphambili sibonisa isitayela sakuqala, esiyisikhumbuzo amaChola ayezosicwenga kamuva.
Water management has played a major role: Ukuphathwa kwamanzi kubambe iqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezolimo we-Tamil Nadu ngoba imvula iyahlukahluka ezinkathini zonyaka nasezifundeni. Imiphakathi yabalimi bendabuko yayisebenzisa imifula, imithombo, amachibi, imisele kanye namathange okunisela ukuze isekele ukulima. Esinye sezakhiwo zokunisela ezibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni yiKallanai, noma iGrand Anicut, ngaphesheya koMfula iKaveri. Ngokwesiko kuthiwa wenziwa inkosi yamaChola uKarikala, yakhelwe ukulawula nokuphambukisa amanzi omfula ukuze aniselwe. Izindawo zezolimo zaseTamil nazo zathuthukisa amanethiwekhi amathangi neziteshi eziqoqa futhi zasabalalisa amanzi emvula esizini. Lezi zinhlelo zazisekela ukutshala ezindaweni lapho imvula iyodwa yayinganele. Ukugcinwa kwazo kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nokuphathwa ngendlela efanele kwemithombo yamanzi. Ukunisela ngenkasa kwendabuko kuhlala kuyisihloko esibalulekile sokuqonda ubudlelwano phakathi kwezolimo, ubunjiniyela, ukuhlaliswa kwabantu, kanye nokujwayela imvelo eTamil Nadu.
Water pots made from clay or metal were: Izimbiza zamanzi ezenziwe ngobumba noma insimbi zazisetshenziselwa ukukha, ukuthwala nokugcina amanzi okuphuza. Imindeni yayithwala amanzi emithonjeni, emachibini nakweminye imithombo yamanzi ngezikebhe ezifanele. Izimbiza zobumba zaziswa kakhulu ezindlini eziningi ngenxa yokuthi amanzi agcinwe odakeni olunezimbotshana angaphola ngenxa yokuhwamuka. Ukusetshenziswa kwazo kwakuncike ezintweni zendawo, amasiko kanye nokutholakala kwamanzi.
Water spills over the anicut when the Ka: Amanzi achitheka phezu kwe-anicut lapho i-Kaveri igijima phezulu. Le filimu ikhumbula ukuthi kungani idamu lalidingeka: ngenxa yezikhukhula umfula wabhodloza usebe lwawo futhi wakhukhula amasimu namadolobhana, njengoba kamuva imibhalo yeChola irekhoda. Ngokuzibamba nokuhlukanisa isikhukhula, uKallanai wavikela umfula kanye nokuwunisela.
Weathered sculpture along the walls of a: Isithombe esibaziwe esinesimo sezulu ngasezindongeni zethempeli lasePallava - ingxenye yalokho esindayo emlandweni wokuqala wedolobha.
Weaving in Tamil Nadu from ancient times: Ukweluka ngesi-Tamil Nadu kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo kuze kube manje - ukotini, usilika, odayi nentambo yendwangu yasendulo yesi-Tamil, izinyathelo ezinhlanu ukusuka ku-fiber kuye kwindwangu, kanye nendaba yabaluki phakathi nenkathi ye-Sangam, imibuso yenkathi ephakathi, ukubusa kwamakholoni nanamuhla.
Weaving is more than a craft: it connect: Ukweluka kungaphezu komsebenzi wezandla: kuhlanganisa izingubo zansuku zonke, ezolimo, ubuchwepheshe, ezohwebo, abasebenzi abanamakhono, ukwaziswa kwamasiko kanye nempilo yemiphakathi yama-Tamil emakhulwini eminyaka. Izinto zayo ezingavuthiwe kwakuyi-paruthi (ukotini), umcu oyinhloko owawuphothwa ube yintambo futhi ulukwe ube yindwangu; i-pattu (usilika), eyaziwa ekuqaleni kwamasiko endwangu aseNingizimu Asia, nakuba imicu eyayisetshenziswa yayihlukahluka ngesikhathi nendawo; odayi bezitshalo abanjenge-indigo, okuxoxwe ngazo ekuqaleni kwezinkomba zendwangu yesiTamil; kanye ne-nool (intambo), i-fiber ephothiwe noma esontiwe ibe yintambo eqhubekayo elungele indwangu yokuluka.
What each landscape gave its people to e: Lokho indawo ngayinye eyanikeza abantu bayo ukuba bakudle: unyaluthi, uju nezithelo zasendle emagqumeni aseKurinji, ubisi, i-curd ne-buttermilk emadlelweni aseMullai, irayisi nama-pulses emasimini aseMarutham, inhlanzi, izinhlanzi ezomisiwe nosawoti ogwini lwaseNeithal, kanye nokudla okuphethwe kwemigwaqo eyomile yasePalai.
When water could not flow naturally from: Lapho amanzi engakwazi ukugeleza ngokwemvelo esuka emfuleni, ethangini noma emthonjeni aye ensimini, abalimi babedinga izindlela zokuwakhulisa. Imikhuba yezolimo yesiTamil yendabuko yayihlanganisa nemishini yokuphakamisa amanzi eyenziwa mathupha njengamabhakede, obhasikidi nezindlela ezisebenza nge-lever. I-picottah, evame ukuchazwa ngokuthi i-lever system engalingani, yenza umuntu akwazi ukuphakamisa amanzi ngomzamo omncane kunokuwaphatha ngesandla. Idivayisi ye-lever evamile isebenzisa isigxobo eside esisekelwe ku-pivot, nesiqukathi esinamathiselwe ekugcineni kanye ne-counterweight kwenye. Umsebenzisi wehlisela isiqukathi emanzini futhi asiphakamise ukuze sichithe amanzi emseleni noma ensimini. Imibhalo yemibhalo yesiTamil, ehlanganisa i-Ahananuru, i-Maduraikanchi ne-Silappadikaram, iqukethe izithenjwa ezihunyushwa njengobufakazi bemikhuba yokuphakamisa amanzi, futhi imibhalo yomlando ikhuluma ngendawo eniselwa ngenkasa kusetshenziswa izinto zohlobo lwe-picottah. Lawa mathuluzi abewusizo ikakhulukazi ezizindeni ezincane, ukulima izingadi namasimu angaphezulu kwamanzi.
Where rain was scarce and the land drier: Lapho imvula yayiyindlala futhi umhlaba wome kakhulu, abalimi baseTamil batshala amabele afana ne-kambu ne-varagu, eceleni kwe-pulses, isesame nokotini. Ukukhetha izitshalo ezifanela umhlabathi ngamunye, imvula kanye nokunikezwa kwamanzi bekuwulwazi izinkondlo zaseSangam esezivele zilubonisa - futhi amabele asele phakathi kwezitshalo ezinkulu zaseTamil Nadu namuhla.
With Puhar, one of the two centres of ea: NgePuhar, esinye sezikhungo ezimbili zamandla eChola aseKaveri.
With the imperial Cholas came a confiden: Nge-Cholas yasebukhosini kwafika uhlamvu lwemali oluzethembayo lwegolide, isiliva nethusi. Izinhlamvu zemali ze-Uttama Chola ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-10 zinegama lakhe, futhi kusukela e-Rajaraja I kuye phambili uphawu lwasebukhosini lubonisa ingwe ye-Chola ehlezi izungezwe izinhlanzi ezimbili ze-Pandya ngaphansi kwe-parasol, negama lenkosi ngombhalo wesiNagari. Ngemva kokunqotshwa kweChola eSri Lanka, uhlobo lwethusi olubonisa inkosi emile ohlangothini olulodwa kanye nomuntu ohlezi ngakolunye lwasakazwa eNingizimu ye-India nasesiqhingini. Amanani abalwa ngesi-kalanju nange-kasu — igama elanikeza isiNgisi “ukheshi” salo.
